misery.line: Do you miss me, Miss Misery
stanza: On March 23, 1998, Smith performed an abridged version of the song at the… I'll…
With some help from Johnnie Walker red
Send the poison rain down the drain
To put bad thoughts in my head
With two tickets torn in half
And a lot of nothing to do
Do you miss me, Miss Misery
Like you say you do?

misery.line: Instead I live my life in constant misery
stanza: There's a life across the river that was meant for me
Instead I live my life in constant misery
There's a life across the river but I do not see
Why I should please those who will never be pleased

misery.line: Now I'm prone to misery
stanza: Oh, oh woe-oh-woah is me
I'm running like a plover
Now I'm prone to misery
The birthmark on your shoulder reminds me

misery.line: The world is treating me bad, misery
stanza: The world is treating me bad, misery

misery.line: Land of brunch and misery
stanza: Land of brunch and misery
I'm living on
The valleys of the young

misery.line: Why let me lead a life of misery
stanza: Unchain my heart
Let me go my way
Unchain my heart
You worry me night and day
Why let me lead a life of misery
When you don't care a bag of beans for me
So unchain my heart
And set me free

misery.line: I wanna be the broken love song that feeds your misery
stanza: If you were a teacher, I would fail your class
Take it over and over 'til you notice me
If you were a waiting room, I would never see a doctor
I would sit there with my first aid kit and bleed
I wanna be the power ballad that lifts you up and holds you down
I wanna be the broken love song that feeds your misery
And I can wish all that I want, but it won't bring us together
Plus I know whatever happens to me, I know it's for the better

misery.songTitle: God’s Song (That’s Why I Love Mankind)
misery.line: From the squalor and the filth and the misery
stanza: "I recoil in horror from the foulness of thee
From the squalor and the filth and the misery
How we laugh up here in heaven at the prayers you offer Me
That's why I love mankind"

misery.line: Well, I guess all that mad misery
stanza: Well, I guess all that mad misery
Must make it seem true to you
But money lights your world up
You're trapped, what can you do?
You got Tennessee tendencies
And chemical dependencies
You make the same old jokes
And malaprops on cue

misery.line: She'll lead you down through misery
stanza: Ride the blue wind high and free
She'll lead you down through misery
Leave you low, come time to go
Alone and low as low can be

misery.line: You have made me a wreck, now won't you leave me in my misery
stanza: Trouble, oh, trouble, move away
I have seen your face and it's too much for me today
Trouble, oh, trouble, can't you see?
You have made me a wreck, now won't you leave me in my misery

misery.line: 'Cause you've seen so much pain and misery
stanza: You already know how rough life can be
'Cause you've seen so much pain and misery

misery.line: But please, remember me, my misery
stanza: But please, remember me, my misery
And how it lost me all I wanted
Those dogs that love the rain and chasing trains
The colored birds above their running
In circles around the well and where it spells
On the wall behind St. Peter
So bright, on cinder gray, in spray paint
"Who the hell can see forever?"

misery.line: Think about me here, here in misery
stanza: Distant lover, ooh (Lover, lover, lover), lover
You should think about me, say a prayer for me
Please, please baby, think about me sometimes
Think about me here, here in misery
(Save me, baby, save me, baby, save me, baby)
Misery (Please, save me, baby, please)

misery.line: To a new misery
stanza: A little girl lost
Her world full of pain
He said it feels good
She gave him her vein
The dope made her numb
And numb felt like free
Until she came down,down,down
To a new misery

misery.line: One step ahead of misery
stanza: I'm only one step ahead of heartbreak
One step ahead of misery
One step is all I'd have to take backwards
To be the same old fool for you I used to be

misery.line: Could never wash away my misery
stanza: Rain drops fallin' from heaven
Could never wash away my misery
But since we're not together
I look for stormy weather
To hide these tears I hope you'll never see

misery.line: Back in elementary, I thrived on misery
stanza: Back in elementary, I thrived on misery
Left me alone, I grew up amongst a dyin' breed

Until I got that Thug Life tatted on my chest, tell me, can you feel me?
I'm not livin' in the past, you wanna last?
Be the first to blast, remember Kato
No longer with us, he's deceased
Call on the sirens, seen him murdered in the streets, now he rest in peace
Is there a heaven for a G? Remember me
So many homies in the cemetery, shed so many tears

misery.line: Honey, makin' a lark of the misery
stanza: Hey, Dorothea, do you ever stop and think about me?
When we were younger, down in the park
Honey, makin' a lark of the misery
You got shiny friends since you left town
A tiny screen's the only place I see you now
And I got nothin' but well wishes for ya

misery.line: Misery!
stanza: Misery!

misery.line: You're gonna cause more misery
stanza: I left you far behind
The ruins of the life that you have in mind
And though you still can't see
I know your mind's made up
You're gonna cause more misery
